Subject: Quick Question & Thank You!

Hi Volunteers,

As we approach the date for our annual charity event, I want to take a moment to thank you all for your dedication and hard work. Let's keep the momentum going and make this year's event the most successful yet!

On a side note, I was just reviewing our historical trivia section for the event and realized I need a quick fact check: who is the explorer credited with reaching America in 1492? If you know the answer, please let me know so I can update the materials.

Together, we can make a difference.

Warm regards,

[Your Name]
